calculation.description: When at least 60% of the tradable cross-asset universe had negative returns on the prior completed day, rank the negative three-day asset return as a contrarian reversal signal, demeaned by the active-date cross-sectional median. The signal is lagged through the breadth condition and is evaluated against five-day forward returns.

validation.regime_notes: Full sample passes both gates at the five-day horizon. IC by regime: 2020-2022 -0.06791 (41 dates), 2023-2024 +0.06709 (46 dates), 2025-2026 +0.11451 (20 dates). The early adverse regime and small regime subsamples imply meaningful uncertainty; monitor online drift.
